title: Kh. Mafjar. Stone Sculpture, I
author: R. W. Hamilton
location_note: Kh. Mafjar (Umayyad palace) north of Jericho; no map reference; placed by name.
reading: p. 47 in full; then eligible-class keyword paragraphs
notes: Study of the capitals and carved stonework from seven seasons. The pool with kiosk in the forecourt is named only as a findspot (described in QDAP X, coded there as QDAP10-153). Stone 'probably quarried' at Kh. es Samra: an attribution, not a recorded feature. No eligible feature coded.
